text.p: - Relocation of the 205 motorifle brigade from Chechnya to the southern Russian town of Budyonnovsk turned into a new disaster for the town which survived a Chechen raid in 1995.
- Authorities of Belarus announced a war on opposition and U.S. citizens critical of the human rights violations in the country.
- Russia says conflict in Minsk is internal problem for Belarus, but it may become an internal problem for Russia as well if the two countries reach a kind of much spoken about union.
- Before the day of nationwide protest actions Russian authorities were seriously defeated at local elections in three regions.
- The head of Russian gas giant Gazprom defends his company against a strong criticism from First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais.
- At a meeting with miners in Kemerovo Anatoly Chubais said it is necessary to restructure coal industry.
- Our huge but extremely weakened country is bound to turn eastwards, shifting emphasis of its foreign and economic policy to China, and the Far and Middle East.
- On the eve of the nationwide strike which is due to start on March 27, the situation in Russia is in many ways similar to the one in October 1993 which ended in bloodshed in Moscow.
